subject: Audit trail retrieval SLA, export formats, and PII redaction options
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@medicosoft.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jacob Park <jacob.park@medicosoft.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit trail retention and export — quick questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking this call yesterday. A couple of follow-ups from our security and legal teams regarding audit/access logs: 

- What are the default and maximum retention windows for audit and access logs for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private deployments?
- Can logs be exported on-demand into a customer-controlled S3/GCS bucket, or is it a managed export delivered by Redwood?
- Which export formats do you offer (JSONL, CSV, syslog, Parquet)? Are exports compressed (gzip/snappy)?
- Is there an option to redact or mask PII before export, or do we need to run a post-export redaction pipeline?
- Typical SLA for a full historical export (e.g., 12–24 months of audit data) — what turnaround should we plan for and any size limits?

If you have a short runbook or template we can share with our auditors, that would be great.

Appreciate it —
Emily Chen
Security Engineer
MedicoSoft
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@medicosoft.com>
Cc: Jacob Park <jacob.park@medicosoft.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit trail retention and export — quick questions

Hi Emily — good questions, thanks. Short answers up front, details below and I attached our audit runbook (redwood_audit_runbook_v2.pdf) plus a small sample export (sample-audit-export-2027-06.jsonl.gz).

1) Retention windows
- Hosted (default): 180 days for access and audit trails; configurable up to 24 months on a per-account basis for paid plans.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): configurable retention up to 36 months (most customers pick 12–24 months).
- Private (self-hosted / VPC): retention is determined by the customer-managed storage; Redwood tooling can be configured to retain indefinitely subject to their storage policy.

2) Export targets and modes
- On-demand exports: yes — we offer two primary modes:
  a) Push to customer bucket (S3/GCS/Azure Blob) using a presigned upload workflow or cross-account replication. You get a bucket manifest and exported files.
  b) Managed delivery: we prepare the export and share via a secure download (HTTPS) or transfer to a Redwood-managed S3 for short-term retrieval.

3) Formats & compression
- Supported: newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) (preferred for large exports), CSV (for tabular audit fields), and syslog (RFC5424) for streaming. Parquet is available upon request for analytics-heavy customers.
- Compression: gzip by default; we also support snappy for Parquet exports.

4) PII redaction and field-level masking
- We provide an export-time redaction option for a defined set of fields (email addresses, IPs, user identifiers) using configurable regex/mapping rules. This runs as an export pipeline so the exported artifacts can be masked before they land in the destination bucket.
- For bespoke redaction logic (e.g., tokenization or custom hashing), we recommend using the customer-side post-processing step in your bucket (we include an example Lambda/Cloud Function in the runbook).

5) SLA & size expectations
- On-demand small exports (<= 100 GB): typically delivered within 24–48 hours.
- Large exports (100 GB–5 TB): 48–96 hours depending on retention window, compression, and queue.
- For multi-TB requests or accelerated delivery we can provision a dedicated export job with a 72-hour SLA for an additional support fee.

Notes on residency and audit integrity
- Exported files are cryptographically signed (SHA256) and we provide a manifest with checksums for verification.
- For EU residency accounts we ensure exports originate from region-specific storage endpoints unless cross-region transfer is explicitly authorized.

Next steps: I can schedule a short session with Neha from product (cc'd) to walk through the export demo and set the retention flags on your account.

Best,
Vivek
VP, Sales — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@medicosoft.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 07:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit trail retention and export — quick questions

Hi Emily — adding a few implementation specifics that often matter to compliance teams:

- Hosted defaults vs max: Hosted default retention is 180 days; account-level increases to 24 months require a configuration change and billing plan adjustment (we've documented the steps in section 3.1 of the runbook).
- Deletion semantics: when a retention window expires (e.g., 180 days), logs are queued for deletion and retained in a soft-delete cache for an additional 14 days for recovery. Permanent deletion is irreversible after that window.
- Residency controls: for customers that elect EU residency, export jobs are launched from EU storage nodes only. If you request exports to a non-EU bucket, we record an explicit cross-border transfer consent and log the action for audit.
- Access control & auditability: export jobs are gated by a two-person approval flow for all hosted accounts where retention > 12 months; approvals are recorded in the audit trail.
- Redaction: our export-time redaction covers common PII fields. If you need field-level, tokenized outputs, we can enable a one-way hash function using a customer-provided salt (HMAC) so hashes are stable across exports but irreversible without the salt.

If you can share the retention period MedicoSoft needs and whether the export destination will be a customer-owned bucket, we can provision a test export this week.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Product Manager, Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vivek/Neha — this is very helpful. MedicoSoft's requirements: 24 months retention for audit logs, push to a customer-owned S3 bucket, and export artifacts must have PII masked (email/IP) and checksums. Can you provision a test export to our staging bucket (we'll share ARN) and confirm the 48–72 hour turnaround? Also, Jacob (cc) will follow up on the cross-border consent language if we need EU-to-US transfers.

Let's plan a short demo on Thu 22 Jul at 11am PT to review the runbook and the sample export output.

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Emily Chen
Security Engineer
MedicoSoft
